svg.title: Delivery pipeline. Commit. Build and test with build, lint, unit tests and a secret scan in parallel. Package: the artifact goes to a registry. Provision: plan and apply create or change the servers. Deploy: a rolling update onto those servers. Observe runs 24/7 and alerts the on-call SRE or DevOps engineer; fixes come back as commits.
